You will learn the workflows, judgment, and verification practices required to use these systems effectively and become a 100x developer.
 



  





 Working at a startup also gives you the opportunity to wear different hats and see problems from engineering, product, customer, and business perspectives. You will gain experience that is difficult to find when working inside one narrow area of a larger company.
 



  





 If you want a fast moving environment, the excitement of solving new problems, and the chance to look back proudly on helping build something significant, this is that opportunity.
 



  





**The Role: Code at the Speed of Thought** 




 Your work will span backend business logic, data models, APIs, integrations, administrative workflows, customer facing interfaces, and automated tests.
 



  





 You will be a full member of the engineering team from day one and trusted with meaningful production work. Important assignments are not reserved for people with longer résumés. You will be held to the same standards for quality, communication, and follow through as every other engineer at Lumion.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 Professional software engineering experience is not required.
 


* **A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science is required.** 
 The degree must be completed before your employment begins. Current students may apply if they will graduate before their start date.
* **Evidence that you have put your programming skills into practice.** 
 This can come from a capstone, internship, personal project, open source contribution, research project, freelance engagement, or another hands on project. We want to understand what you worked on, what you personally contributed, and what you learned.
* **Confidence in at least one programming language.** 
 You can build with it, debug it, and explain the logic behind your decisions. The language does not need to be PHP, and prior Laravel experience is not required.
* **An understanding of web development fundamentals.** 
 You are familiar with concepts such as HTTP, APIs, authentication, databases, browser interfaces, version control, and automated testing.
* **Logical problem solving.** 
 You can break an unfamiliar problem into manageable parts, investigate failures systematically, and work toward the underlying cause.
* **Product judgment.** 
 You consider the person using the software and connect technical decisions to the problem being solved.



  





**How We Work** 




 Lumion is a high trust team. We share context openly, keep our egos low, raise risks early, and ask questions when something does not make sense.
 



 To show that you read the entire posting, tell us in your application what you would do with a golden banana. There are no wrong answers except not answering.
 



  





**The Stack** 




 Our current application stack includes:
 


* **Application:** 
 PHP 8\.4\+, Laravel 12\+, Livewire, Filament, Blade, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS
* **Data:** 
 MySQL, Redis, pgvector, and Pinecone
* **Testing:** 
 Pest PHP



  





**Why Join Lumion Now?** 




 Lumion closed a $10\.7 million seed round backed by TTV Capital and Tusk Venture Partners. More than 400 career schools use our platform to support over 150,000 students across 48 states and 29 industries.
 



  





 Schools using Lumion see 47% more completed applications, a 73\.6% application to enrollment rate, 91% on time tuition collection, and 21% higher student retention.
 



 We have the capital and momentum to build something that lasts while remaining early enough for every engineer to influence the product and company.
 



  





**Remote First** 




 This is a full time remote position. You must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States. Your normal workday must overlap by at least six hours with our Salt Lake City team.

 $80,000 to $100,000 USD

 Meaningful stock options
* **Bonuses:** 
 Quarterly performance based cash bonuses
* **Time Off:** 
 Unlimited paid time off
* **Retirement:** 
 401(k)
* **Health:** 
 Health, dental, and vision reimbursement up to $537\.50 per month
* **Technology:** 
 $200 monthly technology stipend
* **Wellness:** 
 $100 monthly wellness stipend

 Position Description:
   

  

 Employees in this job function are responsible for designing, building, and operating high\-throughput backend systems that ingest, process, and serve large volumes of telematics data from connected vehicle fleets. They work at the intersection of distributed systems, data engineering, and API development — delivering reliable, low\-latency services that power fleet intelligence products for commercial and enterprise customers. Design and develop scalable, high\-performance backend services and APIs that process and expose telematics data — including GPS, trip events, driver behavior, vehicle diagnostics, and sensor telemetry — at fleet scale Build and maintain real\-time and batch data pipelines that ingest high\-volume vehicle event streams from messaging systems (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka) into data warehouses and operational stores
   

  

 Skills Required:
   

  

* GCP: Design, deploy, and manage workloads on GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC networking, Cloud Composer, etc.), including provisioning infrastructure, configuring security/access controls, and troubleshooting performance or cost issues in production. Expert 3\+ years
* Big Data: Design and optimize data pipelines and storage architectures for large\-scale, high\-volume/high\-velocity datasets using tools such as Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, or Dataflow; strong understanding of distributed computing, partitioning, and data lake/warehouse patterns. Expert 3\+ years
* Artificial Intelligence \& Expert Systems: Build, train, and deploy machine learning models or rule\-based expert systems to support decision automation (e.g., predictive maintenance, fraud detection, recommendation engines); familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Vertex AI; ability to explain model outputs to non\-technical stakeholders. Expert 1\+ years
* API: Design, build, secure, and document RESTful (or GraphQL) APIs, including authentication/authorization (OAuth2, API keys), versioning, rate limiting, and integration with internal and third\-party systems. Expert 3\+ years
* BigQuery Write: optimized SQL queries in BigQuery; manage datasets/partitioning/clustering for performance and cost control; integrate BigQuery with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Data Studio) or downstream applications for reporting/analytics. Expert 2\+ years


 Skills Preferred:
   

  

 Google Cloud Platform: Broader GCP ecosystem knowledge beyond core required
   

  

 GCP skill — e.g., Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, GKE (Kubernetes), Cloud Build/CI\-CD pipelines, or cost\-optimization/FinOps practices — that strengthens overall platform capability. Expert 3\+ years
   

  

 Experience Required:
   

  

 Senior Engineer Exp: Prac. In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang.; guides. 7\+ years in IT; 5\+ years in development
   

  

 Experience Preferred:
   

  

 Languages: Kotlin, Java, Python, or equivalent JVM/backend language Frameworks: Spring Boot, gRPC, REST API design Data: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Redis, Bigtable, Kafka or Pub/Sub Infrastructure: GCP (or equivalent), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines Practices: TDD, MLOps\-adjacent data pipeline patterns, database performance tuning, API versioning
   

  

 Education Required:
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree
   

  

 Education Preferred:
   

  

 Certification Program

 Hybrid (4 days per week in the office)
